description: The line plot illustrates the validation performance of two models, SMoE and SimSMoE, over the course of training, as measured by the Bits Per Character (BPC) metric. The x-axis represents “Training Steps,” scaled in thousands (×10³), ranging from 0 to 50, with major tick marks at intervals of 10 (i.e., 0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50). The y-axis displays “BPC,” ranging from 1.1 to 2.2, with major tick marks at intervals of 0.2 (i.e., 1.2, 1.4, 1.6, 1.8, 2.0, 2.2). Two lines are plotted: the black line with triangle markers labeled “SMoE Validating” and the magenta line with diamond markers labeled “SimSMoE Validating.” Both lines begin near BPC = 2.15 at 0 training steps and exhibit a steep decline in BPC during the first 10,000 steps. The SimSMoE line starts slightly higher but converges with the SMoE line around 10,000 steps. From approximately 20,000 steps onward, both lines stabilize near BPC = 1.15, with minor fluctuations. The SimSMoE line remains slightly above the SMoE line for most of the training duration, though the difference diminishes over time.
